source.citation: Meheust Y, Delord K, Bonnet-Lebrun AS, et al. 2024. Oecologia 204:675-688.

method_reported_by_source.breeding_success: fledged chicks / breeding pairs for each colony and breeding cycle
method_reported_by_source.temporal_correction: annual growth was smoothed by subtracting annual mean growth across colonies; breeding-success and growth quantities were corrected for temporal variability before lag correlation
method_reported_by_source.interpretive_hypothesis: positive one-year lag was interpreted by the authors as coherent with prospecting new breeders using public information

relationship_to_palmer.concordance: The independent Pointe Geologie system also shows a positive short-delayed breeding-performance/growth association after annual temporal correction, qualitatively concordant with the Palmer history-dependent signal.
relationship_to_palmer.important_difference: The external published lag profile turns slightly negative at the next lag, whereas the Palmer fixed-specification coefficients remain positive through its lag-3 endpoint before fading.
relationship_to_palmer.specificity: This literature evidence establishes cross-system recurrence of a short-lag pattern but does not identify public information as the causal carrier.

epistemic_boundary: Values are reported results from the paper, not recomputed from raw data.
The Figshare raw-data replication gate remains blocked in the current runtime.
Do not count the reported p-values as new independent tests performed in mina.
Do not claim exact methodological equivalence to the Palmer model until the deposited data are reanalyzed under the frozen replication contract.
